question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the infrastructure sector?
solution:
The correct answer is **Agriculture**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Agriculture** is primarily considered a part of the primary sector, which involves the extraction and harvesting of natural products from the earth.
 
• The **infrastructure sector** includes essential physical systems and facilities like transport, energy, and water management.
 
• **Dams** are part of the infrastructure sector as they are critical for water management and hydroelectric power generation.
 
• **Highways** are vital infrastructure for transportation, facilitating the movement of goods and people.
 
• **Power** infrastructure includes generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity, which is fundamental for economic activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Infrastructure Type
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Transportation
 Includes **highways**, railways, airports, and seaports essential for the movement of people and goods.
 
 

 Energy
 Comprises **power** plants, transmission lines, and distribution networks that provide electricity.
 
 

 Water Management
 Includes **dams**, reservoirs, and pipelines for water supply and irrigation.
 
 

 Telecommunications
 Involves networks and services for communication, such as internet and telephone lines.
 
 

 Healthcare
 Comprises hospitals, clinics, and medical facilities that provide health services.
